segments.title: consistent action and experience

spans.nul: Plural number is fused into English lamas; no separate exponent.

spans.tib: byed pa rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu
myong ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bur

spans.nul: Closing assertion particle has no separately alignable English exponent.

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment reconciled by Codex. dga' bar owns takes pleasure and 'gyur ba owns become; the latter is not swallowed by the enjoyment phrase. The second English killing is the object of pleasure; the first is additional causal exposition. Both consistent-result expressions are established technical compounds, including the inflected experience term ending in 'bras bur. Their unique tighter members mark action/experience, consistent and consequence. rnams contributes the plural fused into lamas; do closes the assertion without a separate exponent. Great, supplied participants/articles, and the explanatory causal framing remain unwrapped. mir skyes na yang and de dag la have distributed renderings and are omitted; the second rnams and conjunction dang are not forced into then. snga ma owns just listed, leaving the explicit supplied noun results unwrapped; myong ba is banked once as experience, not again as undergo. C09:153/C17:500 conjecture rnam smin for the second rgyu mthun, while C05:196/C16:774 and both local S05392L readings retain rgyu mthun. No correction is imposed.

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment reconciled by Codex. The complete environmental/dominant coordination is d3: the single shared English consequence and HGM's variable use of these labels do not justify isolated reversed adjective atoms. The outer-world phrase is also d3. Food and drink, digest and hard, disease and cause remain lexical atoms; no auxiliary or connective is absorbed. nus pa owns potency and stobs owns nutrition in reversed English order. The two chung ba occurrences own the two little tokens. crops excludes the explanatory in the fields, and sogs pa owns only other, excluding the supplied noun things. The complete lifespan recast tshe ma zad par yang 'chi bar 'gyur ba owns die before reaching the end of a full life at d3; it is not a dictionary compound. bskyed pas is retained as the inflected verb cause; the causal contribution of its suffix -pas is distributed into Because of this and has no separate pairing. las, topic ni, list linkers and supplied discourse/participants are omitted where their contributions are distributed; none is falsely nulled. The HGM glossary attests bsnyems pa/inferior; source forms remain verbatim.

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment reconciled by Codex. The first, second and fifth Tibetan 'bras bu occurrences map to all three English crops tokens, with the intervening predicates and than pa/char fixing the last occurrence. The third and fourth noun occurrences are pronominalized as they; they are omitted from the lexical bank rather than declared untranslated. nyung ba/few and far between and grung pa/power are exact HGM glossary entries. mi owns no; to remove hunger is explanatory and stays unwrapped. The first 'gyur ba owns spoil. long ba is omitted, not nulled: blind/needy glossary senses and the exact local crop context do not securely establish the metaphorical never come up reading. The rejected 'bras bu long ba/never come up pairing also drops its crop subject; adding they repairs that subject boundary but does not establish the uncertain predicate. ches pa expresses excess duration then excess quantity. med par 'gyur ba/die off is a complete productive resultative predicate at d3, despite its glossary attestation. Supplied framing, auxiliaries and list linkers remain unwrapped.
